column3: Close to the Hebrew; “all my inward parts” is rendered “all that is within me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
“Your ornament” (a word of uncertain meaning) is rendered “your years”; the meaning is uncertain.
NASB adds “with us” and “His anger”: the Hebrew says “he will not always contend, nor keep [it] forever.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it is strong” is rendered “So great is.”
Close to the Hebrew; “our form” is rendered “our frame.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his kingdom” is rendered “His sovereignty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his servants” is rendered “You who serve Him.”
